source: AS/NZS 1170.2:2021: site wind speed Vsit = VR Md (Mz,cat Ms Mt) (2.2), design pressure p = (0.5 ρair) Vdes² Cfig Cdyn with 0.5 ρair = 0.6 (2.4), Cfig = Cp,e Ka Kc,e Kl Kp of the walls (5.2, 5.4), Cdyn = 1 (buildings above 1 Hz, 6.1)

TC1.description: Terrain category 1: exposed open terrain, few or no obstructions; water surfaces

TC2.description: Terrain category 2: open terrain, grassland, few well scattered obstructions 1.5-10 m high

TC3.description: Terrain category 3: numerous closely spaced obstructions 3-10 m high (suburban housing)

TC4.description: Terrain category 4: large city centres, numerous large high (10-30 m) closely spaced obstructions

sources.speedFactors.airFactor: AS/NZS 1170.2:2021 2.4.1: p = 0.5 ρair Vdes² with ρair = 1.2 kg/m³ (0.6 Vdes² [Pa])
sources.speedFactors.heightFactors: AS/NZS 1170.2 Table 4.1: terrain/height multiplier Mz,cat (k2 of the method) of TC1-TC4 at 3-200 m, linear between, the 3 m value below (values of the 2011 edition's table; the 2021 edition adds TC1.5 and TC2.5 and may revise them: to be checked)
sources.speedFactors.riskCoefficients: AS/NZS 1170.2 Table 3.1(A): VR of the annual probability of the importance level (AS/NZS 1170.0 Table 3.3) over V500 (the town's speed), at V500 = 45 (regions A0-A5, NZ1, NZ2), 51 (NZ3), 57 (B1, B2), 66 (C) and 80 m/s (D): k1 of the method; the regional values of the 2011 formulas (A 67 - 41 R^-0.1, W 104 - 70 R^-0.045, B 106 - 92 R^-0.1, C 122 - 104 R^-0.1, D 156 - 142 R^-0.1) rounded; the 2021 regions' values to be checked
sources.speedFactors.importance: AS/NZS 1170.2 4.3: shielding multiplier Ms = 1.0 (no shielding taken, conservative; k4 of the method: set wind.speedFactors.importance for Ms, or for the climate change multiplier Mc of the 2021 edition in regions B2, C and D: uncertain, to be checked)
sources.speedFactors.combination: AS/NZS 1170.2 5.4.3, Table 5.5: Kc,e = 1.0 taken (SAEngine practice, conservative); the table allows 0.8-0.9 where several surfaces act together: set wind.speedFactors.combination
sources.speedFactors.areaAveraging: AS/NZS 1170.2 5.4.2: Ka = 1.0 for windward and leeward walls
sources.directionality: AS/NZS 1170.2 3.3: wind direction multiplier Md = 1.0 (any direction; the largest, conservative: override wind.directionality with the region's Md of the governing direction)
sources.topographic: AS/NZS 1170.2 4.4: topographic multiplier Mt = Mh Mlee Ms = 1.0 on flat ground; enter Mt in Project Settings > Wind (the hill multiplier Mh of 4.4.2 is not computed)
sources.gust: AS/NZS 1170.2: regional speeds are 0.2 s gusts, the pressure coefficients need no gust factor (1.0); Cdyn = 1 (6.1, buildings with n1 > 1 Hz; the dynamic response factor of Section 6 is not computed)
sources.cpLeeward: AS/NZS 1170.2 Table 5.2(B): leeward wall Cp,e by d/b: -0.5 (<= 1), -0.3 (2), -0.2 (>= 4), roof pitch below 10° (linear between)
